blocks.note: Distinguish reflexive self-reference from emphatic mismo, solo, and other non-reflexive translations of English self.
Correct person agreement, tonic reflexive forms, body-part possession, and spurious reflexive pronouns.
Transform caused events into intransitive changes and affected-person constructions without treating se as a literal self.
Contrast lexical meanings and complement patterns of paired pronominal and non-pronominal verbs.
Choose quedar or quedarse from arrangement, location, retention, and resulting-state meanings.
Express an indefinite agent with passive se, impersonal se, or uno while applying agreement and personal-a diagnostics.
Repair learner sentences by separating definite subjects, passive patients, personal objects, and truly impersonal agents.
